# Auckland Dinner Menu for 6 on 5 Sep 2026

A relaxed, budget-aware dinner plan for **6 people** in Auckland with **1 vegetarian** and **1 gluten-free** guest. I’ve kept the menu flexible so the same table can work for everyone with minimal special handling.

## Menu Options, Costed for Your Budget

| Course | Option | Fits Veg / GF | Est. ingredient cost | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Starter | Roasted pumpkin soup + toasted seeds | Vegetarian, gluten-free | NZD 18 | Easy, cozy, and fully shared |
| Starter | Tomato bruschetta on gluten-free crostini | Vegetarian, gluten-free if bread is GF | NZD 22 | Fresh and light; use separate bread |
| Main | Lemon herb roast chicken, potatoes, carrots, green beans | Gluten-free | NZD 58 | Best value for a crowd |
| Main | Lentil, mushroom, and spinach bake with salad | Vegetarian, gluten-free | NZD 46 | Main vegetarian anchor; hearty and filling |
| Dessert | Baked apples with cinnamon and vanilla yogurt | Vegetarian, gluten-free | NZD 20 | Low-cost, simple, crowd-pleasing |
| Dessert | Dark chocolate mousse with berries | Vegetarian, gluten-free | NZD 28 | Richer option; still manageable on budget |

## Best Combination for Your Dinner

**Recommended menu**
- **Starter:** Roasted pumpkin soup + toasted seeds
- **Main:** Lemon herb roast chicken, potatoes, carrots, green beans
- **Dessert:** Baked apples with cinnamon and vanilla yogurt

**Why this works**
- Covers the vegetarian and gluten-free needs cleanly.
- Keeps the menu simple enough for one cook.
- Stays comfortably within budget with room for pantry items and contingencies.

**Estimated total ingredient cost:** **NZD 96–112**
- Starter: NZD 18
- Main: NZD 58
- Dessert: NZD 20
- Pantry extras, herbs, oil, lemon, yogurt, seasonings: NZD 10–16

**Budget note:** This leaves about **NZD 28–44** buffer under your NZD 140 cap, which is useful for better-quality chicken, dessert extras, or drinks.

## Simple Shopping List

**Produce**
- 1 medium pumpkin or butternut squash
- 1 kg potatoes
- 1 kg carrots
- 500 g green beans
- 2 onions
- 1 bulb garlic
- 2 lemons
- 4 apples
- Fresh parsley or thyme
- Optional salad greens

**Protein / Dairy**
- 1 whole chicken, about 1.8–2.2 kg
- Vanilla yogurt
- Optional cream or extra yogurt for soup/dessert

**Pantry**
- Olive oil
- Vegetable or chicken stock
- Pumpkin seeds or sunflower seeds
- Cinnamon
- Honey or brown sugar
- Salt and pepper

**Optional swaps**
- If you want a fully vegetarian main, replace chicken with **lentil, mushroom, and spinach bake** and add a side salad.
- If you want a more polished dessert, replace baked apples with **dark chocolate mousse and berries**.

## Prep Timeline for 19:00 Dinner

**Day before**
- 16:00–17:00: Buy ingredients
- 17:00–17:30: Wash and prep vegetables
- 17:30–18:00: Make soup base or roast pumpkin
- 18:00–18:20: Mix dessert components if using mousse
- Chill, cover, and store

**Dinner day**
- 15:30: Take chicken out of fridge briefly before cooking
- 16:00: Roast pumpkin soup base reheat or finish soup
- 16:15: Prep chicken and vegetables
- 16:45: Put chicken and potatoes in oven
- 17:30: Add carrots, then green beans later
- 18:15: Warm soup and set table
- 18:30: Finish dessert
- 19:00: Serve starter

**Serving flow**
- 19:00 starter
- 19:30 main
- 20:15 dessert
